zh.title: 航空短訊彙整：美國七家航空公司遭訴訟指控 涉共用數據聯合抬高票價；美國航空暌違六年在 LAX 恢復 Flagship Dining
zh.summary: 本期收錄2則獨立消息：美國七家航空公司遭訴訟指控 涉共用數據聯合抬高票價、美國航空暌違六年在 LAX 恢復 Flagship Dining。
body: 本期彙整2則航空短訊，各則為獨立事件。

1. 美國七家航空公司遭訴訟指控 涉共用數據聯合抬高票價
訴訟指控美國7家航空公司涉嫌共用資料庫監控票價；迅速跟進比價並聯合抬高機票價格。

2. 美國航空暌違六年在 LAX 恢復 Flagship Dining
美國航空暌違六年在 LAX 恢復 Flagship Dining，並擴大商務艙使用權限。

en.title: Aviation briefs: Lawsuits Accuse Seven US Airlines of Colluding to Raise Fares via Shared Pricing Data; American Airlines Brings Flagship Dining Back to LAX After Six Years
en.summary: 2 independent updates: Lawsuits Accuse Seven US Airlines of Colluding to Raise Fares via Shared Pricing Data; American Airlines Brings Flagship Dining Back to LAX After Six Years.
body:
1. Lawsuits Accuse Seven US Airlines of Colluding to Raise Fares via Shared Pricing Data
Seven US airlines face lawsuits alleging use of a shared database to collude and raise fares.

2. American Airlines Brings Flagship Dining Back to LAX After Six Years
American Airlines returns Flagship Dining to LAX after six years, with expanded business-class access.
